verdict.rationale: Channel3 has its own agentic search mode, in which an LLM plans a natural-language request into deterministic filters and sub-searches. Its MCP server lets users drive it from Claude or ChatGPT without writing code. Natural-language control is documented only for search, and community hands-on queries such as "red high top sneakers under $40" ignored the price constraint and returned irrelevant results, so NL reliability is questionable. Missing for 10: natural-language operation beyond search (e.g., price tracking, lookups), independent confirmation that agentic mode parses constraints reliably, and in-depth docs on the NL command scope.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Toggle to agentic mode, and an LLM plans the search: it extracts deterministic filters, may split the request into OR/AND sub-searches
You can use it without writing any code, and without an API key.
